faq.checkinOutQ: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq.checkinOutA: Check-in from 2:00 PM and check-out by 12:00 PM. Flexible times may be requested at the front desk, subject to availability.
faq.breakfastA: Yes, all room categories include a full breakfast served at the hotel restaurant.
faq.cancellationA: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in date. After that, the first night will be charged.
faq.parkingA: Yes, we offer secure parking for all guests.
faq.petsA: Yes, we are pet friendly! We have rooms prepared to welcome your pet. Let us know when booking to ensure the best room.
faq.paymentA: We accept credit card, debit card, Pix and cash. Payment is made at check-in.
faq.evA: Yes, we have an electric vehicle charging station available free of charge for guests.
faq.eventsA: Yes, we have a spacious event venue for meetings, training sessions and gatherings. Contact us for quotes: +55 (31) 3881-8049.

about.title: About the Hotel
about.tradition: Hospitality benchmark in Zona da Mata
about.p1: Hotel & Restaurant Paraíso is the choice of executives, families and travelers passing through Ponte Nova. With a central location and easy access, we offer the perfect balance of comfort, convenience and authentic Minas Gerais hospitality.
about.p2: Four room categories — from the accessible Confort to the complete Master Suite — all with breakfast included and the quality standard that made us a regional benchmark.
about.p3: Parking, high-speed Wi-Fi throughout, event venue for corporate gatherings, EV charging station, and pet-friendly rooms. Everything designed so you only worry about what matters.
about.p4: 150 km from Belo Horizonte via BR-262, Ponte Nova is a regional hub that receives professionals from across the state. Our hotel is the natural base for those seeking comfort and location — minutes from downtown and major businesses.
